learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn to collect smart information and show it using fun charts like pictographs and pie charts!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pictograph uses cute little pictures or symbols to show numbers. For example, drawing one smiley face can mean 5 children!
A circle graph looks like a yummy round pizza! We cut it into slices to show different parts of a whole group.
By looking at these fun graphs, we can quickly answer questions like who read the most books or which fruit is loved the most in class.

fun_activity.title: 🍎 Fruit Pictograph
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your family their favourite fruit. Draw a chart and put one star sticker for every person next to the fruit they love!

quick_recap: ⭐ Data is useful information that we collect and organize neatly.
⭐ Pictographs use fun symbols and pictures to represent numbers easily.
⭐ Circle graphs or pie charts show how a whole group is divided into different slices.
